source.question: How does a confirmed appointment become a notification outcome and the next STAFF action?

scope.label: SCOPE / notification delivery and STAFF action
scope.meaning: Connects notification intent, delivery outcome, and reminder recovery for one selected operating scope.

version.label: VERSION / baseline commit f0c7614

edges.kind: read the member profile at send time
validate consent, destination, and language; build typed payload
check state, reason code, and next action
future: keep the next send time
due: enqueue within the catch-up window
missed: suppress and decide the final state
already exists: converge on the same idempotency key
query cursor, checkpoint, and recovery result

decision.label: Final State Decision
decision.rule: Record one of sent, suppressed, retry wait, or exhausted and expose the STAFF recommendation.

outcomes.next: Re-read status and the action queue
Wait until the next retry time

budgetRationale: The four delivery outcomes and the future/due/missed/already-exists reminder boundary fit in one view; provider details remain in the article.

repairs.reason: Keep scope and version fixed below the title without covering the main nodes.
Align every connector start and end with a real card boundary.
Use only horizontal and vertical segments with rounded corners; reject diagonals.
Match every arrowhead fill to its connector color.
Reserve an independent row between each call line and its label.
Replace a dotted or implicit terminal rail with a named Final State Decision node.
Size operations cards and action-queue headings for the longest label instead of shrinking type.
Keep reminder recovery as a supporting panel and omit an all-clinic rollout board.
